results.title: BCPA Broward County Property Appraiser's Office
results.snippet: The Broward County Property Appraisers Office (BCPA) is responsible for determining the value of all property in Broward County for the purpose of property tax assessment. The BCPA's mission is to provide accurate, fair, and equitable property valuations to ensure that property owners pay only their fair share of property taxes.
